title: Cyberpunk Ninja
premise: Kanshi Dynamics owns the Kanshi Spire and everything below it. Its CEO, the Daimyo, is building an army of super soldiers by tearing the soul out of the city's people and throwing it away. Without a soul, a body obeys and doesn't complain when its parts are replaced with cybernetic enhancements. Kuro, the Daimyo's bodyguard and the Academy's master instructor, found out and turned on him. The Daimyo split him in two: his body became Mukuro, the obedient captain of the hollowed guard, and his soul was thrown down the Spire like everyone else's. Discarded souls fade within minutes. Kuro's did not. Tethered to life by rage and missing most of his memories, it fell into the Sump Scrapyard and woke a scrapped Kanshi robot: Hotaru. Hotaru believes she is a living person who lost her memories. Kuro only knows that someone at the top of the Spire killed him. They climb together, him for revenge and her for answers, while the hollowed army prepares to march on the rest of the city.

lore.soul_and_mind: A soul is what keeps a body alive and wanting things. A mind is memory and personality. Kuro's mind rides on his soul. Hotaru's mind grew on that same soul after it woke her frame. One soul can keep only one body alive for long.
lore.kuro_memories: When Kuro was split, his memories tore three ways. Some came with his soul: how to fight, and how the city and Kanshi work. Those memories are where Hotaru's skills come from. Some broke off as Memory Shards. The rest stayed in his body, Mukuro.
lore.hollowing: The Daimyo's extraction tears the soul out of a person. The body lives, obeys, and remembers how to fight, but wants nothing. The soul is vented out of the Spire and fades. Hollowing cannot be undone.
lore.the_army: Most of the city is still free. The hollowed soldiers, drilled at the Academy and mustered in the Tenshu, are about to march on the city to capture and hollow everyone else.
lore.hotaru_frame: HTR-0 'HOTARU' was a prototype from Kanshi's first super-soldier program: robot Shinobi frames with phase drives. They were scrapped because a machine without a soul cannot improvise. The Daimyo switched to hollowing people. Kuro's soul is what made the frame work, and the fighting memories that came with it are where her skills come from. Her name is the model name stamped on her chassis.
lore.memory_shards: Pieces of Kuro's memory that broke off when he was split from his body; the rest stayed in Mukuro. They scattered down the Spire and across the city as his soul fell, so one waits in every area.
lore.the_pipeline: Big Oni sells Sump residents to Kanshi and delivers them to the Pachinko Vaults. Lady Luck sends up debtors who lose everything. Both go down a freight lift to Platform 9, a Kanshi Line station hidden off the Sewers, and ride the monorail up to the Spire. Kanshi's factories poison the Sump, and the Physic Gardens on the Spire's lower floors sell the cure at a huge markup. Every road leads to the Academy, where people are hollowed.

cast.Hotaru: Scrapped prototype frame HTR-0, woken by Kuro's soul. Dry, guarded, and certain she is a person. Her scarf shows her Phase Step charges. The game's central question is whether she is alive. She is.
cast.Kuro: The soul of the Daimyo's former bodyguard, with only some of his memories: how to fight and how the city works, but almost nothing of his own life. Sardonic, driven by rage, and slowly remembering who he was. He appears as a violet glitch at the edge of Hotaru's visor.
cast.Mukuro: Kuro's body, hollowed. Captain of the Daimyo's guard and the Academy's enforcer. He has Kuro's skill and the memories that stayed in the body, and none of his soul.
cast.Tetsu: A one-armed ramen cook in the Sump and Kuro's oldest friend. He lost his arm when a Kanshi drone malfunctioned; Kanshi covered it up, and he's been digging into the company ever since. He treats Hotaru as a stranger, but some of her habits remind him of someone.
cast.DaiCam: A Sump livestreamer climbing the Spire for views. Comic relief who keeps getting into trouble, until his stream becomes the city's warning.
cast.Big Oni: Boss of the Hannya Boys. Kanshi pays him to keep the Sump penned in and to sell its people.
cast.Dobunushi: 'Lord of the ditch.' A mass of mutants fused around a broken Kanshi outflow pipe in the Sewers.
cast.Lady Luck: Croupier who runs the Pachinko Vaults. Kanshi pays her to keep the city gambling, broke, and distracted, and per head for the debtors she sends up.
cast.The Harmacist: Head of Kanshi's Physic Gardens, on the Spire's lower floors. She sells the Sump the cure for the sickness Kanshi's factories cause, at whatever price it will bear.
cast.The Daimyo: CEO of Kanshi Dynamics. A human man in a samurai exoskeleton who believes the soul is the root of every riot, strike, and theft. He carries Tamakiri, the blade that split Kuro.
cast.Debtor: A Sump man who gambled everything at the Pachinko Vaults and lost himself as collateral. Hotaru passes him in the debtors' line, and finds him again at the Academy's intake.
cast.Receptionist: The Kanshi Spire's front-desk man, sword under the counter. He doesn't let unauthorized scrap through his lobby.

branches.description: One choice at the end of Chapter 5 decides the rest of the game. A scene whose condition is 'branch: kuro_spared' or 'branch: kuro_destroyed' plays only on that branch. 'optional' marks a scene the player can skip (repeat talks); 'optional; branch: ...' means both. Scenes with no condition play on every branch.
branches.kuro_spared: Hotaru and Kuro compromise: he gets his revenge, she gets her answers, and he stops fighting her for control. He rides along through the Physic Gardens. In Chapter 7 Kuro realizes he can possess Mukuro, his own former body, and asks Hotaru to bring it along. At the Last Shrine he moves into it and fights beside her in the first two phases of the final battle. One soul cannot keep two bodies alive, so after the Daimyo falls Kuro lets go and leaves the whole soul to Hotaru.
branches.kuro_destroyed: Hotaru destroys Kuro's mind and keeps the soul for herself. She climbs the rest of the Spire alone, from the Physic Gardens up. Mukuro can only be put down, and she faces the Daimyo by herself.

Big Oni.who: Gang boss of the Hannya Boys. He guards the gate out of the Sump, toward the Pachinko Vaults.
mechanics: Slow club swings: deflect them.
Heavy Strikes (Phase Step, then attack) stagger him.
Phase 2 overhead slam is a Breach that sends a shockwave across the roof: jump it or Phase Step through.

Lady Luck.who: Croupier who runs every table on the Vaults tier.
mechanics: A slot machine behind her picks each attack, and names it when the reels stop (CARD FAN!, SHOCKWAVE!, LASERS!...).
Deflect her card-blades to send them back.
SHOCKWAVE is a Breach: jump or Phase Step. Jackpot turns on laser grids: Phase Step through them.

Dobunushi.who: A mass of polluted mutants fused around a broken Kanshi outflow pipe.
mechanics: Sludge rises in waves from the bottom of the arena: stay on the platforms while the tide is high.
Its arms slam down onto platforms: deflect the slam, then cut the arm. Each arm has its own Stance bar.
With both arms cut, its core opens: strike it until the arms regrow.
Phase 2 toxic spew is a Breach wave across the floor: jump it or Phase Step through.

Raijin.who: The Kanshi Line's enforcement locomotive, built to ram anyone on the tracks who doesn't belong.
mechanics: Its reactor core is shuttered except while it vents steam: strike it then.
Deflect its cannon shells straight back into the core.
Deflect or jump the pantograph arm; step off roof sections that spark before they go live.
Phase 2: when the horn sounds, jump the plow it drags across the roof.

Kuro.who: Kuro's mind, fighting Hotaru for control of the frame inside the space they share.
mechanics: Uses Hotaru's own moves: the 4-hit string, blink strikes from behind, and a Breach Phase Cut.
When he Phase Cuts at you, Phase Step through him at the same moment to Clash, which breaks his Stance.
Possession: when the screen edges turn purple, left and right are swapped.
When his last segment breaks he kneels: press E to reach out and compromise, or attack to destroy his mind. This choice sets the branch for the rest of the game.

The Harmacist.who: Head of the Physic Gardens on the Spire's lower floors, armed with a vial bandolier and a stim injector.
mechanics: Throws vials in arcs: deflect them back at her.
Poison clouds linger where vials break: they sting (damage without staggering), so leave the cloud or Phase Step through it.
When she pulls out a stim to heal, interrupt her with a Heavy Strike.
Phase 2: she injects herself, gets faster, and she can crush a vial to jet forward on the gas before it bursts into a poison cloud that acts as a Breach.
Defeated, she kneels and pleads her case, then limps out of the Apothecary once Hotaru answers.

Mukuro.who: Kuro's hollowed body. Captain of the Daimyo's guard.
mechanics: A duelist who guards everything except right after his own combos.
Deflect each strike to build Stance damage, then punish openings with two or three hits; greed gets countered.
Holds strikes to bait early deflects.
Phase 2 adds a kunai fan, a diving slam that sends shockwaves along the floor (jump them), and a shadow that strikes from behind.

The Daimyo.who: Kanshi's CEO, in his samurai mech, then as its eye wired into the castle, then in person.

forms.name: Samurai mech
forms.mechanics: A red samurai mech with a glowing blue katana. Deflect the iaido draw and the 3-slash strings, jump the shockwaves when it leaps and stomps, Phase Step through the thruster charge, and strike while it recovers.
forms.ally: kuro_spared: Kuro (in Mukuro's body) fights like Hotaru: he flanks the armor, deflects, Phase Steps Breaches, cuts into its openings and Heavy Strikes its guard. He goes down in one hit, and gets back up once per Memory Shard collected (a shard burns above him).

forms.name: Castle defenses
forms.mechanics: The broken mech's eye rises on a cable and wires itself into the Tenshu: shut while it floats and the castle fires. Turrets fire bullet barrages: deflect them back into the eye, and strike when it drops to the floor and opens to recharge.
forms.ally: kuro_spared: Kuro keeps fighting (every other turret volley targets him; he deflects most of it back into the eye) until the end of this phase, then collapses.

forms.name: The Daimyo, in person
forms.mechanics: The eye crashes to the floor and stays there, going dark, as he steps out to duel with Tamakiri. The fight runs on a beat. Every cut string and the iaido draw open on a 0.9 s windup. First half: a da-da-DA 3-cut string, an iaido draw that dashes across the floor (deflect it as he passes), a counter stance (striking into it gets you riposted; wait it out and he lowers his guard for a brief opening), and a soul-grab Breach: Phase Step through it, or he holds Hotaru up for a second, draining 3 health (which heals him) and 9 Stance, then throws her. His openings are short, so the duel is won by deflecting. At half health he lets out a kiai and speeds up, adding the Tempest (he leaps into the air, spins in a whirlwind and throws three red slash waves at Hotaru; deflect them back into him, then punish the long landing), a 7-cut storm string, and a 5-cut rend string where he blinks behind Hotaru; the 3-cut string drops out. He flashes white before every cut, and breaking his Stance drops him to one knee.

core_combat: Attack chains into a 4-hit combo; Up + attack is a rising Launcher.
Phase Step (Space): an invincible, aimable dash with one charge (the scarf greys out while it's spent). Passes through lasers and attacks; refills on landing or a perfect deflect.
Heavy Strike: attack during or right after a Phase Step. It can't cut through a guard or a deflect, but it builds a lot of enemy Stance.
Deflect: press Down right before a hit lands (enemies flash white just before). A perfect deflect builds the attacker's Stance. Holding Down blocks, but blocking builds Hotaru's Stance.

Stance: every fighter has a Stance bar, Hotaru included. It starts empty and fills gold under pressure, then slowly settles (more slowly the lower a fighter's health, down to half speed; Hotaru's only with her guard down). When an enemy's Stance fills and breaks, a red reticle appears: attack near it to perform an Execution (instant kill for regular enemies, a whole health segment for bosses). Every Execution also refills one gourd charge and clears Hotaru's Stance. When Hotaru's Stance breaks, she overheats and staggers.
Breach: a red diamond marks an attack that cannot be blocked or deflected (guarding against one still costs Stance). Phase Step through it or jump it.
survival: Nano-Gourd (R) heals; upgraded to 4 charges after Big Oni.
Shrine Terminals (hacked vending machines, E) heal, refill the gourd and set the respawn point.
traversal: Wall cling and wall jump; jump up through thin platforms, double-tap Down (or Phase Step down) to drop through.

Lifts and shafts: the Scrapyard lift up into Neon Alley; the freight shaft behind Lady Luck's table, dropping into the Sewers; the service lift from the Apothecary up into the Academy; the Spire Lift behind Mukuro's Ring, up into the Tenshu.
Toxic pools and rising sludge tides (Sewers). Each room starts at low tide; a TIDE RISING warning flashes and the pumps gurgle before each rise.
Laser grids pulse on and off (Vaults, Castle).
Greenhouse heat vents carry you upward; some vents pulse (Physic Gardens).
Headwind, bottomless gaps between cars, and Kanshi patrol crows skimming the roofs (Monorail).
Phasing blocks: two sets alternate being solid every few seconds; the incoming set lights up and turns solid just before the other vanishes (Hollow Floor, Academy).
Possession: Kuro periodically swaps left and right (Hollow Floor).
enemies: Croupier dealers who throw card-blades, and slot turrets (Pachinko Vaults).
Drainlings: irradiated zombies covered in glowing pustules who lunge and spit sludge (Sewers).
Memory echoes of Kuro's past fights (Hollow Floor).
The Spire Lobby's receptionist, a suit grunt behind the desk (Physic Gardens).
Garden Wardens: guarded duelists you must deflect to break, and sprayer drones (Physic Gardens).
Hollowed trainees: Kuro's former students, who dash in and throw kunai (Academy).
Hollowed soldiers, castle turrets, beams, and lasers (Tenshu).
mechanics.collectibles: Nine hidden Memory Shards, one per area. Each is a piece of Kuro's memory that broke off when he was split from his body. The memories play in order, oldest first, whichever shard you find; nothing outside them depends on finding them.

chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.title: Sump Scrapyard
chapters.summary: A scrapped Kanshi robot wakes up in the Scrapyard with a soul that isn't supposed to exist. Hotaru believes she's a person who lost her memories. Kuro, the voice in her head, only knows that someone at the top of the Spire killed him. Tetsu the ramen cook has never met her, but one of her habits stops him cold.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: KANSHI DYNAMICS // HTR-0. Shinobi frame, prototype. Status: SCRAPPED.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Pilot: NONE. ...Pilot: DETECTED. Source: UNKNOWN. Motor control: OK. Memory index: NOT FOUND.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Rain. Cold. Scrap metal everywhere. Where am I?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: My name... is Hotaru. I seem to remember that much, but not much else.
Good. You're awake. Try not to die before I figure out whose body this is.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...What?
Never mind. Get up before the drones find you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Who said that? There's no one here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I'm in your mind. I don't know how I got in, so don't ask. Maybe you're malfunctioning.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And the purple ghost flickering at the edge of my visor?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Also me. Call me Kuro. Seems like we're both amnesiacs... I remember how to fight and how this city works.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: My own life, though? Almost nothing. Except one thing.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Which is?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Somebody at the top of that tower--the Spire--killed me. And I'm going to return the favor.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're dead? You're talking to me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Dead men talk, apparently. What about you? Some junkyard robot dumped in a scrapyard?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm a real person, thank you very much. At least... I think I am.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I just have more... cybernetic enhancements than most. Someone seems to have knocked me out and put me here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...Sure, whatever you say. Whatever happened, something tells me the Spire will have answers. The Kanshi Spire: HQ for the mega-corp that runs this city.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You want your answers, I want my killer. Let's start climbing.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Scavenger drones. They strip anything that stops moving.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: So don't stop moving. Cut them down in the air.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wall turret. You'll struggle to reach it from here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Catch the round on your blade at the last instant and send it home.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Kanshi laser fence. It'll burn you if you touch it, but you should be able to phase right through.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Why do I have all these enhancements...?

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Well, look what the storm dragged in. Haven't seen you around here.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I just woke up in your scrapyard.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Ha. Sounds like you had a rough night. Sit. Eat something. It's on the house.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Hotaru taps her chopsticks twice on the rim of the bowl before she eats.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Nothing. I used to know a kid who did that, a long time ago.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: That vending machine's a Shrine--hacked it myself. Rest there, and it'll fix you up and fill up that healing gourd of yours.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Nice old man. Suspicious how he's helping us.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're awfully paranoid.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hard to survive in this city otherwise.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: You're heading up to the Spire? Can't say that's a good idea, but I don't imagine I can convince you not to go.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: You'll need to go through Neon Alley, which belongs to the ruthless Hannya Boys gang.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Kanshi pays them to keep us down here, separating us slum-dwellers from the rest of the city.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: If you give up... or if you accomplish whatever you're trying to do there... come back and eat something here when you're done.

scenes.trigger: Reach the edge of the Scrapyard

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Neon Alley. Past those masks is the only way out of the Sump.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And past that?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Up and up, until we start getting some answers.

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: Neon Alley
chapters.summary: The Hannya Boys keep the Sump penned in and sell its people to Kanshi. Hotaru meets DaiCam the livestreamer and executes Big Oni, whose ledger shows where the captives go: up the Spire, by way of the Pachinko Vaults next door.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Neon Alley. The Hannya Boys run these floors. Oni masks, steel pipes, bad manners.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Let's go teach them a lesson.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Ha. My thoughts exactly.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: See the bar over his head? That's his Stance. You have one too, at the bottom of the screen.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect his swings and hit him hard. When his Stance breaks, you'll see a bullseye indicator. Click it to execute him.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay chat, okay, this is fine. This is content.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Guys? Guys, I'm not for sale! I have a very large audience! People would notice!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Looks like they've got some streamer cornered.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, we have a NINJA. Say hi to the chat.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Okay, she's not saying hi. Chat, she's walking away.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You don't look like you're from the Sump. Get back to safety.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: And miss out on exclusive content? Smash that follow, ninja lady!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That one looks tougher. If you see a red diamond appear above him, a Breach attack's coming.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You can't block it and you can't deflect it. Phase Step to dodge it instead.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Three of them, and they've locked the doors. Use the platforms. Don't get surrounded.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Looks like we're approaching the gang boss.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's a big one, guarding the gate out of the Sump. He's slow, though.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: When he lifts that club over his head, you hit him hard or you get out of the way.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Rest at the Shrine first. I'd hate to lose this body. I'm just getting used to it.

lines.speaker: Big Oni
lines.text: A runaway from the Scrapyard? Kanshi pays double for the ones with chrome.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: That's him, Big Oni, boss of the Hannya Boys. Deflect the club swings.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Heavy Strikes stagger him: Phase Step, then attack. Break his Stance and execute him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's angry now. Watch the overhead slam. It's a Breach attack.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jump the shockwave or phase through it.

lines.speaker: Big Oni
lines.text: Kanshi... pays on time... What did I care where they went...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: What's he talking about?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Looks like he dropped something--a ledger of some sort?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: A list of names, dates, and prices... Every one delivered to the Pachinko Vaults.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And from there, up the Spire. To somewhere called 'the Academy'.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Academy... I've heard that before. Why do I know this?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Vaults are right through that gate. If the captives went through there, so do we.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: ...and CUT. Chat, did everybody clip that?! Ninja lady just took down Big Oni! We're trending!

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: The Pachinko Vaults
chapters.summary: Big Oni's captives come through the city's biggest casino, along with every debtor who loses everything to Lady Luck. Her slot machine picks her moves, and somebody upstairs set the odds. Beaten, she gives up where the captives go next: a secret monorail station off the Sewers.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Pachinko Vaults. The city's biggest casino, where Kanshi turns addictions into profit.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And where Big Oni delivered his captives. They have to be in here somewhere.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let's move quickly. This place can be addictive--I've seen too many people end up enslaved by the games here.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Laser grid. It pulses on and off, and Kanshi stations dealers behind it.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Wait for a gap, or Phase Step straight through it. Mid-fight, if you have to.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Slot turrets. Chucks three card-blades at a time.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Deflect the one coming at you and it goes straight back to whoever threw it.

scenes.trigger: A line of debtors being led away

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: These are the people from the ledger... but also some others?

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: ACCOUNT CLOSED. Balance: 0. Collateral: SELF. Destination: ACADEMY INTAKE.

lines.speaker: Debtor
lines.text: You! You're not with them, are you? Please, I'll pay it all back, I swear. Just don't let them send me up there!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hang on. I'll find out where they're taking you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Lose your money, lose yourself--seems like these people gambled away even their freedom.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: They're being shipped out like freight. Let's find out where.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: High rollers' lounge. The dealers here throw from the balconies. Get up there with them.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, I am currently being held as collateral. I bet my stream. I lost my stream. The stream is still running.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Ninja lady! You came for me! For the content!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I came here chasing answers.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Same thing! Hit the cage! Before they send me 'up for processing,' whatever that is!

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: FREEDOM! I'm calling this episode 'Jackpot'.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You shouldn't gamble. Call 1-800-MY-RESET if you think you have a problem.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: I'm not gambling, I'm INVESTIGATING gambling. Totally different. Byeee!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: We're coming up on Lady Luck's tables. She runs the casino, but the slot machine behind her runs her.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Watch the reels. Spades, sevens, cherries... and if they land on skulls, get off the floor.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: And if it hits the jackpot?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Then we find out how fast you are.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Well, well. What do we have here? A junkyard robot far away from home. HTR-0 model, it looks like.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Hotaru is my name. I'm a human being.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Sure you are, sweetheart. Place your bet, then, little firefly. Everything you have.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Deal.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Double or nothing!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Jackpot means lasers. Phase Step through them!

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: The house... always... wins...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Not this time, chrome-dome. Where are you sending them?

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: Down the freight shaft behind my table, sweetheart. To a station that isn't on any map: Platform 9, under the Sewers.

lines.speaker: Lady Luck
lines.text: The Kanshi Line runs from there straight up to the Spire. Every debt gets paid upstairs.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: A secret monorail stop. That's our way to the upper city.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat, the ninja just broke the bank. Literally. Somebody clip the reels!

scenes.trigger: The edge of the freight shaft

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: No lift. It already went down with the debtors.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then we take the short way down.

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The Sewers
chapters.summary: The way to Platform 9 runs through sewers fed by Kanshi's factories. The waste has twisted the people who work down here into Drainlings. At the outflow, a mass of them has fused into Dobunushi, and behind it is the secret station.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: That smell... What is that?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Heh. We're in a sewer. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I guess you wouldn't know since you're a robot.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: Monorail Ascent
chapters.summary: Platform 9 is a freight station hidden off the Sewers, where the Kanshi Line loads its captives for the ride up to the Spire. Hotaru rides it anyway. The Daimyo appears for the first time, with Mukuro at his side, and recognizes Kuro. Raijin's black box finally tells both of them what they are.

lines.speaker: Kuro

chapters.title: Hollow Floor
chapters.summary: Kuro tries to take the frame for himself. Inside the space they share, built from his broken memories, Hotaru fights to prove she's alive. When he falls, she chooses: compromise with him, or destroy his mind and keep the soul for herself.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I think I could get back in. Not here, not yet. But when the time comes.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You want me to bring him?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I want you to bring me. Please.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Then we're carrying you to the top.

lines.speaker: Mukuro
lines.text: Integrity... compromised. Systems... offline.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Time to finish this. Goodbye, Kuro. Goodbye, Mukuro.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm sorry. I think you'd have wanted this.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: His door's open. There's a lift back there.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: The Spire Lift. Straight up to the Tenshu. That's where he'll be.

lines.text: The Spire Lift. Straight up to the Tenshu, and the Daimyo.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: The Tenshu
chapters.summary: The Daimyo's castle above the clouds and the smog, where the hollowed army musters to march at dawn. If Kuro was spared, he moves into his old body and fights beside Hotaru until the strain of one soul in two bodies drops him. Then the Daimyo steps out of his armor and duels her alone.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: We're above the clouds. Look at the moon! I've never seen it this clear.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Well, you've only been alive for a day...

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: But you're right: There's no smog up here. Kanshi pumps it all down to us.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The Daimyo keeps this view all to himself...

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Last climb, partner. Don't drop my body.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I'm above the clouds. Look at the moon! I've never seen it this clear.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: There's no smog up here. I guess Kanshi pumps it all down to us.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: The Daimyo keeps this view all to himself...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Time to confront him.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Feel the wind here. Feel the clean air blow.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Castle defenses. Lasers, beams, turrets. Every trick you've already beaten.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MUSTER HALL // 1,206 soldiers. Target: LOWER CITY. Objective: CAPTURE AND PROCESS. Departure: DAWN.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: They're going to do to the whole city what they did to Kuro's students.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Hotaru! I rode the lift up behind you, and I'm live! Chat, this is the army. This is what's coming. Get out of the city! Tell everyone.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: DaiCam. How many people are watching?

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Two million and climbing! Go stop him. I'll keep the camera rolling.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: This is the place. Lay my body down by the Shrine.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: What'll happen to me if you go?

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I think my soul should be able to move both of us, at least for a while. I hope.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Soul link established: HTR-0 and MUKURO. Load: CRITICAL.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: ...My body. The one given to me by my parents... twisted, but still me.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Let's go knock on the Daimyo's door. It's time for a corporate restructure.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Captain! You're wearing yourself again. And you brought the toaster!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're not going to get away with this.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The toaster... speaks? On its own? Does it have its own...

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: No... Ah, I see!

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: One soul, two bodies. I can see it straining from here. You can't keep this up.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: One of you is going to disappear. I wonder which of you will let go first.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Neither of us is going anywhere until you're finished.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Then come on in. It's time to put you in your place.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Kuro? No... HTR-0. The robot. You've taken his soul for your own. Ha, you monster!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He might be gone, but his grudge remains. I'll take you down in his name.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Then come on in. It's time to put you in your place.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The soul... is the root of every riot, every strike, every crime. Cut it out, and a city runs like a clock.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: My perfect soldiers will defend this city from every outside threat, as no ordinary humans ever could.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: People aren't clocks.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: How insightful! You are a clever toaster, aren't you?

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Now, kneel.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Never.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Get ready--I'm right at your side. We'll do this together.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Enough! The castle itself will finish you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He's getting reckless. Deflect those bullets right back at him!

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: The castle itself will finish you.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You're getting reckless. I'll deflect those bullets right back at you.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hotaru... I'm falling apart. Our soul can't support us both. I can't hold my end.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Kuro!

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I'm still here. I just can't stand. Finish it--I'll watch.

scenes.trigger: Phase 3: the Daimyo steps out of the armor

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Enough machines. I'll do this myself.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Tamakiri cut your captain in two. It will cut you out of that frame like a bad wire.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then come and try.

lines.speaker: The Daimyo
lines.text: Without me... they'll stand there forever... waiting for an order that won't come...

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: We'll figure out a way to restore them--if not, we've at least stopped you from doing this to more.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: MUSTER HALL // Command signal: LOST. March order: CANCELLED.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Hotaru. Come here. I don't have long, and I want to say this right.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: He was right, you know. One soul can't keep two bodies alive. One of us has to let go.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Then we go back to sharing! Get back in my head.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: There's no room. You grew into all of it. That's how it should be.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: I came back for revenge, and I got it. I've had my time... you deserve a chance at life.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: You were looking for answers. Well, here it is: You're alive. You are your own person, not just a copy, not just a shell.

lines.speaker: Kuro
lines.text: Go see the sunrise from up here. Then, go tell Tetsu the kid came home.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Soul link: RELEASED. Soul: 100% assigned to HTR-0.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...Kuro?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: It's over.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: You'd have wanted to see this, Kuro. I hope I did it the way you would have.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Above the clouds, the sky is starting to turn gold.

chapters.label: Epilogue
chapters.title: Tetsu's Cart
chapters.summary: Ramen in the rain with Tetsu and DaiCam. The city is safe, and the hollowed stand without orders. If Kuro was spared, Tetsu learns the kid came home. If not, Tetsu never knows, and Hotaru still taps the bowl twice.

scenes.trigger: Back at Tetsu's cart, in the rain

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat up, kid. Nobody climbs a tower on an empty stomach.

lines.speaker: DaiCam
lines.text: Chat! Forty million! The whole city watched! They're calling it 'The Firefly Climb'!

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Please don't call it that.

scenes.trigger: A hollowed soldier stands near the cart

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Some of them--the hollow ones--wander down here now. No orders. They just stand in the rain.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: I feed them when they come. Somebody needs to.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: Tetsu. The kid who tapped his bowl... His name was Kuro, right?

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: ...How do you know that name?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: He helped me go up the tower. He said to tell you the kid came home.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: ...He always came back here. Every time. Stupid kid.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Eat. You tap the bowl just like him, you know.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: I know.

scenes.trigger: Hotaru's scarf flickers violet for a moment

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Hotaru's scarf flashes, and she briefly feels like Kuro is still there, with her always.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Something wrong?

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...No. Nothing's wrong at all.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: There it is again. You tap the bowl like somebody I used to know.

lines.speaker: Tetsu
lines.text: Just a kid who went up the tower and never came back.

lines.speaker: Hotaru
lines.text: ...May he rest in peace.

memories.description: Nine Memory Shards are hidden one per area. Whichever shard Hotaru picks up, the memories play in this order: the first shard found plays memory 1, the second memory 2, and so on. A memory may lean on the ones before it, but nothing else in the story depends on them. Before the Kuro choice and on the kuro_spared branch Kuro remembers aloud; on kuro_destroyed the shard plays as a fragment and Hotaru reacts alone.
